name: Copilot Setup Steps

# Runs before the Copilot cloud agent starts to prepare its ephemeral environment. In addition
# to installing PHP, Composer, and npm (and running Boost via the post-autoload-dump hook), this
# provisions Postgres and Redis services and prepares landlord/tenant testing databases so the
# agent can execute the app's commands, tests, linting, and formatters.
on: # zizmor: ignore[concurrency-limits]
    workflow_dispatch:
    push:
        paths:
            - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml
    pull_request:
        paths:
            - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml

permissions: {}

jobs:
    # The job MUST be named `copilot-setup-steps` or Copilot will not pick it up.
    copilot-setup-steps:
        name: Copilot Setup Steps
        runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

        permissions:
            contents: read

        timeout-minutes: 20

        env:
            php-extensions: gd, gmp, redis, mailparse
            php-extensions-key: ext-cache-copilot-v1
            php-version: '8.4'
            DB_PORT: 5432
            DB_HOST: 127.0.0.1
            DB_USERNAME: root
            DB_PASSWORD: root
            DB_DATABASE: testing_landlord
            REDIS_HOST: 127.0.0.1
            REDIS_PORT: '7000'

        services:
            postgres:
                image: postgres:15@sha256:6eb0add3b77c081df18aa518ce43df58fdcc40f2e6d868a6fd08038dc7acd425
                ports:
                    - 5432:5432
                env:
                    POSTGRES_DB: testing_landlord
                    POSTGRES_USER: root
                    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: root
                options: >-
                    --health-cmd pg_isready
                    --health-interval 10s
                    --health-timeout 5s
                    --health-retries 5

        steps:
            # A real 3-master cluster (ports 7000-7002) matching the cluster-mode ElastiCache Serverless used in staging and production.
            - name: Start Redis (3-master cluster)
              run: |
                  docker run -d --name redis --network host \
                    redis:7.4.12@sha256:bd28fff4b665fdf1b73e8b5b73ec05d2f858f4fa3c8ea0d7c9bc09f7f6bf7039 \
                    sh -c '
                      for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                        redis-server --daemonize yes --port "$port" --appendonly no --save "" \
                          --cluster-enabled yes --cluster-config-file "nodes-$port.conf" --cluster-node-timeout 5000
                      done
                      for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                        until redis-cli -p "$port" ping | grep -q PONG; do sleep 1; done
                      done
                      redis-cli --cluster create 127.0.0.1:7000 127.0.0.1:7001 127.0.0.1:7002 --cluster-replicas 0 --cluster-yes
                      tail -f /dev/null
                    '

                  for port in 7000 7001 7002; do
                    until docker exec redis redis-cli -p "$port" cluster info | grep -q 'cluster_state:ok'; do sleep 1; done
                  done

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
